name: IC Analog — SPI — VSON
description: Analog IC cluster featuring SPI interface and surface-mount VSON-8-1EP footprint.
selection_hints: Select when requiring surface-mount analog ICs with an SPI interface.
Use when board layout matches the VSON-8-1EP footprint (3x3mm, 0.65mm pitch, EP 1.65x2.4mm).
Suitable for designs using KiCad symbol library Tier B analog parts.
avoid_when: Avoid when an interface other than SPI is required.
Do not use if the board layout requires non-VSON packaging or non-SMD mounting.
Avoid if verified Tier A library components are strictly required.
